item.title: Week 11: Raiders at Broncos
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 4:25 PM ET | Line: DEN -10 · O/U 40.5 | Model DEN 80% vs. market 82% | Denver needs its short passing game to win after the catch, because a Las Vegas pass defense ranked 32nd in EPA per dropback gives those throws room to turn into drives. Jaylen Waddle, who averages 3.5 yards of separation, runs into a pass defense that ranks last, giving Bo Nix a clear target. Our model sits close to the market's 82% on Denver, with the passing matchup contributing the most to that lean.
